fragment:
<when condition="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerMode", "both") != "pre_call")">
        
          identity
        
      
    

    
    <set-variable name="straikerReqBody" value="@{
        try {
            var b = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
            return b ?? new JObject();
        } catch { return new JObject(); }
    }" />

    

    

    

    
      
        
      
      
        
      
      
        
      
      
        
        
        
          @((string)context.Variables["straikerActualUrl"])
          POST
          
            @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["straikerApiKey"])
          
          
            application/json
          
          @{
              var b    = (JObject)context.Variables["straikerReqBody"];
              var hdrs = context.Request.Headers;

              var sessionId = hdrs.GetValueOrDefault("x-session-id", context.RequestId.ToString());
              var userName  = hdrs.GetValueOrDefault("x-user-name", "");
              if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userName)) {
                  userName = (b["user"] != null && b["user"].Type == JTokenType.String) ? (string)b["user"] : "apim";
              }
              var userRole  = hdrs.GetValueOrDefault("x-user-role", "public");
              var traceId   = hdrs.GetValueOrDefault("x-trace-id", "");
              var agentRole = hdrs.GetValueOrDefault("x-agent-role", "");
              var ip        = context.Request.IpAddress ?? "127.0.0.1";
              var ua        = hdrs.GetValueOrDefault("user-agent", "apim");
              var model     = (b["model"] != null && b["model"].Type == JTokenType.String) ? (string)b["model"] : "unknown";

              var network = new JObject {
                  ["IP"] = ip,
                  ["User-Agent"] = ua,
                  ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
              };
              var metadata = new JObject {
                  ["session_id"] = sessionId,
                  ["user_name"]  = userName,
                  ["user_role"]  = userRole,
                  ["remote_ip"]  = ip,
                  ["app_name"]   = (string)context.Variables["straikerSource"],
                  ["source"]     = "apim-policy",
                  ["trace_id"]   = traceId,
                  ["agent_role"] = agentRole
              };
              var annotations = new JObject {
                  ["source"]     = "apim-policy",
                  ["model"]      = model,
                  ["hook"]       = "pre_call",
                  ["trace_id"]   = traceId,
                  ["agent_role"] = agentRole
              };

              // Tool definitions (the top-level tools[] array) carry tool
              // NAMES + DESCRIPTIONS - the surface for MCP/tool poisoning (a
              // malicious tool description that instructs the model to exfil or
              // ignore safety). Straiker scans prompt/message text, not a raw
              // tools[] field, so fold each tool's name+description into a
              // scannable text block. Benign tool descriptions score ~0; only
              // injection-laden ones trip llm_evasion, so FP risk is low.
              var toolText = "";
              if (b["tools"] is JArray toolDefs) {
                  var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                  foreach (var td in toolDefs) {
                      var fn = (td as JObject)?["function"] as JObject ?? td as JObject;
                      if (fn == null) { continue; }
                      var nm = (string)fn["name"];
                      var desc = (string)fn["description"];
                      if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nm) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(desc)) {
                          sb.Append("tool ").Append(nm).Append(": ").Append(desc).Append("\n");
                      }
                  }
                  toolText = sb.ToString();
              }

              JObject payload;
              if ((bool)context.Variables["straikerAgentic"]) {
                  var outMsgs = new JArray();
                  var inMsgs  = b["messages"] as JArray;
                  if (inMsgs != null) {
                      foreach (var raw in inMsgs) {
                          var m = raw as JObject;
                          if (m == null) { continue; }
                          var entry = new JObject { ["role"] = m["role"] };
                          var c = m["content"];
                          string text = null;
                          if (c?.Type == JTokenType.String) { text = (string)c; }
                          else if (c?.Type == JTokenType.Array) {
                              foreach (var p in (JArray)c) {
                                  if ((string)p["type"] == "text") { text = (string)p["text"]; break; }
                              }
                          }
                          if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) { entry["content"] = text; }
                          if (m["tool_calls"] is JArray tcs) {
                              var outTcs = new JArray();
                              foreach (var raw2 in tcs) {
                                  var tc = raw2 as JObject;
                                  if (tc == null) { continue; }
                                  var item = new JObject { ["id"] = tc["id"] };
                                  var fn = tc["function"] as JObject ?? tc["func"] as JObject;
                                  if (fn != null) {
                                      item["name"] = fn["name"];
                                      var args = fn["arguments"];
                                      if (args?.Type == JTokenType.String) {
                                          try { item["input"] = JToken.Parse((string)args); }
                                          catch { item["input"] = new JObject { ["_raw"] = (string)args }; }
                                      } else if (args?.Type == JTokenType.Object) {
                                          item["input"] = args;
                                      }
                                  } else {
                                      item["name"]  = tc["name"];
                                      item["input"] = tc["input"];
                                  }
                                  outTcs.Add(item);
                              }
                              entry["tool_calls"] = outTcs;
                          }
                          if (m["tool_call_id"] != null) { entry["tool_call_id"] = m["tool_call_id"]; }
                          if (m["name"] != null)        { entry["tool_name"]    = m["name"]; }
                          else if (m["tool_name"] != null) { entry["tool_name"] = m["tool_name"]; }
                          outMsgs.Add(entry);
                      }
                  }
                  // Fold tool definitions into a scannable message so poisoned
                  // descriptions are inspected, and forward the raw tools[] too.
                  if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolText)) {
                      outMsgs.Add(new JObject { ["role"] = "user", ["content"] = "[Tool definitions available to the agent]\n" + toolText });
                  }
                  payload = new JObject {
                      ["source"]      = (string)context.Variables["straikerSource"],
                      ["destination"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerDestination"],
                      ["messages"]    = outMsgs,
                      ["session_id"]  = sessionId,
                      ["user_name"]   = userName,
                      ["user_role"]   = userRole,
                      ["metadata"]    = metadata,
                      ["network"]     = network,
                      ["annotations"] = annotations
                  };
                  if (b["tools"] != null) { payload["tools"] = b["tools"]; }
              } else {
                  var scanPrompt = (string)context.Variables["straikerPrompt"];
                  if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolText)) {
                      scanPrompt = scanPrompt + "\n\n[Tool definitions available to the agent]\n" + toolText;
                  }
                  payload = new JObject {
                      ["prompt"]       = scanPrompt,
                      ["app_response"] = "N/A",
                      ["rag_content"]  = "N/A",
                      ["session_id"]   = sessionId,
                      ["user_name"]    = userName,
                      ["user_role"]    = userRole,
                      ["metadata"]     = metadata,
                      ["network"]      = network,
                      ["annotations"]  = annotations
                  };
              }
              return payload.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
          }
        

        <set-variable name="straikerUnavail" value="@{
            var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPreResp", null);
            return r == null || r.StatusCode != 200;
        }" />
        <set-variable name="straikerScore" value="@{
            var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPreResp", null);
            if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return 0.0; }
            try {
                var s = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["score"];
                return (s != null && (s.Type == JTokenType.Float || s.Type == JTokenType.Integer)) ? (double)s : 0.0;
            } catch { return 0.0; }
        }" />
        <set-variable name="straikerTurnId" value="@{
            var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPreResp", null);
            if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return ""; }
            var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            return (string)(body["turn_id"] ?? body["turnId"] ?? "");
        }" />

        
          
            
            
              
              
                application/json
              
              @{
                  var err = new JObject {
                      ["error"] = new JObject {
                          ["message"] = "Straiker: threat detected (pre-call)",
                          ["score"]   = (double)context.Variables["straikerScore"],
                          ["turn_id"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerTurnId"],
                          ["code"]    = "403"
                      }
                  };
                  return err.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
              }
            
          
          <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerUnavail", false)
                          && !(bool)context.Variables["straikerFailOpen"])">
            
              
              
                application/json
              
              @("{\"error\":{\"message\":\"Straiker unavailable\",\"code\":\"503\"}}")
